title: FtO Seoul 2026 (Facing the Ocean Meet & Hack)
description: This is to announce that the 2026 FtO will be held in Seoul between 18th to 20th September (with 19-20th being the main event).
More info coming later, along with registration, but now the venue and dates are fixed, you can book your trip in advance!
Some basic info about our venue is [here](https://g0v.hackmd.io/@fto/book/%2FhDu0pA9QQeWS9z_8SVkmvA?type=book)
Hope to see you there! As we are collaborating with a creative youth centre in Seoul - we're hoping to get more participants under 24!
raw:
9/18-9/20 FtO Seoul 2026 (Facing the Ocean Meet & Hack)
- This is to announce that the 2026 FtO will be held in Seoul between 18th to 20th September (with 19-20th being the main event).
- More info coming later, along with registration, but now the venue and dates are fixed, you can book your trip in advance!
- Some basic info about our venue is [here](https://g0v.hackmd.io/@fto/book/%2FhDu0pA9QQeWS9z_8SVkmvA?type=book)
- Hope to see you there! As we are collaborating with a creative youth centre in Seoul - we're hoping to get more participants under 24!
